subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When a stage skill that authors or reviews a feature contract runs for a draft-born feature, the skill shall read and write that feature's draft only.
rationale: The stage skills are reworked for drafts (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-11, brainstorm:feature-draft#D-16)
fit_criterion: Every contract-authoring and contract-reviewing stage skill run against the end-to-end fixture writes only draft content, with zero document-corpus writes.
